name: App Requests
tagline: Ask. Vote. Watch it get built.
description:
App Requests is the community board for the apps and features you want on Civitai. Post an idea, up-vote the ones you want most, and watch what people care about rise to the top.

The board opens ranked by votes, so the most-wanted ideas are the first thing you see. Search filters the requests that have been loaded, and the board tells you when it is looking at only part of a large board rather than pretending otherwise.

A request is a title plus optional details. As you write one, the board surfaces requests that already look similar — up-voting one of those lifts it faster than splitting the vote across a near-duplicate. Your own posts stay yours: edit one in place to fix a typo without losing the votes it has collected, or withdraw it, which removes the request and its votes for good. Every request also carries a Report action that sends it to Civitai moderators for review.

Voting is one vote per person per request, and you can up-vote as many requests as you like. Click a vote again to take it back.

Anyone can read the board signed out; posting, voting and reporting need a verified account at least seven days old and in good standing. Nothing here spends Buzz and nothing is generated — just ideas and votes. Posts are moderated, so keep it kind and constructive.

scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:read: Lists the shared board of app/feature requests visible to all users.
scopeJustifications.apps:storage:shared:write: Posts, edits, up-votes, withdraws and reports requests on the shared board visible to all users, and lets the app owner append the moderation record that hides a request from this board.
scopeJustifications.user:read:self: Reads the viewer's identity to attribute their own posts and gate author-only edit/withdraw.
